articles.summary: TypeSafe's Jev is pitched at exactly the decisions that sit around a phone call. We put it on three real jobs against 17 models: it is 1.7 to 3.3 times faster everywhere, level with the best on judging and extraction, and not ready for routing.
articles.title: Testing Jev on real phone calls

articles.summary: Customers wanted to drop a Bolna agent onto their website. We budgeted five to six weeks, had a proof of concept in two, and shipped in about three - by reusing the telephony stack we already ran.
articles.title: Shipping browser calls in under two weeks with Kamailio and FreeSWITCH
